put.description: Marks a maintenance record as COMPLETED and returns the asset to AVAILABLE status.
Approves a pending asset. Only HR and Super Admin can perform this action.

post.description: Moves an asset into IN_PROGRESS maintenance status and logs the history.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all assets with optional filtering.

post.description: Registers a new asset into the system with its purchase details, category, location, and department.
Transfers an already assigned asset from the current user to a new user.
Assigns an available asset to a specific user.

get.description: Fetches a list of all maintenance events (active and completed).
Fetches an analytics report identifying underutilized assets based on assignment history.
Fetches summarized metrics of all assets.
Generates a PNG QR code image for a specific asset based on its assetCode.
Retrieves a list of asset assignments. Can be filtered by status.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Allowed values: 'active' (currently assigned), 'returned' (past assignments), or leave empty for all.

role.description: Represents the user's role in the system for RBAC.
